create_shrunk_covariance: create a shrunk covariance matrix from an empirical covariance using a given shrinkage coefficient
build_ledoit_wolf_estimator: build a Ledoit-Wolf shrunk covariance estimator from sample data with automatic shrinkage computation
build_oas_estimator: build an Oracle Approximating Shrinkage covariance estimator from sample data
test_ledoit_wolf_shrinkage: test the Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage coefficient computation for given sample data
run_ledoit_wolf: run the Ledoit-Wolf algorithm to estimate a shrunk covariance matrix and shrinkage coefficient from data
